title: AO/255/1995 of U.P.STATE ROAD TRANSPORT Vs THE MOTOR ACCIDANT CLAIMS AND OTHERS

paras.text:
AO No. 136 of 2001
(FAFO No. 255/1995)
Hon'ble B.C. Kandpal, J.
(Abatement Application No. 9096 of 2006)
 List has been revised. None has
appeared on behalf of the appellant.
 An application for abatement of the
appeal has been filed by the respondent on the
ground that the respondent No. 3 has died on
15.09.2003 but no steps for moving substitution
application has been taken as yet by the
appellant.
 None for the appellant is present to press
the appeal while Sri S.S. Negi, learned counsel
for the respondents No. 4, 5 and 6 is present
before the Court.
 Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed
being abated.
 Accordingly, the abatement application is
disposed of.
Money Withdrawal Application No. 12726 of 2006
 Heard Sri S.S. Negi on the money
withdrawal application moved by the
respondents No. 4, 5 and 6.
 In view of the dismissal of the appeal, the
respondents No. 4, 5 and 6 who are the legal
heirs of respondent No. 3 are permitted to
withdraw the awarded amount deposited with
the claim tribunal.
 Money withdrawal application is
disposed of accordingly.
